text:
Maya: Quick sync — I sketched a phased rollout for the tenant-priority feature + new quantized model (v2-q4). Need consensus on cohorts, telemetry gates, and fallback policy before we schedule the shiproom. High-level plan: 3-phase canary (5% -> 20% -> 100%), AB for quality with a small holdback for offline eval, and auto-fallback to v2-q2 if we see regressions. Main asks: define exact SLOs, success metrics, and canary duration. Thoughts?

Liam: Sounds reasonable. Proposal notes: phase windows = 24h each but make Phase 1 72h to gather signal. Canary sampling should be stratified (small/mid/large tenants) — include at least one large tenant in phase1. Auto-thresholds: error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 20% => rollback. Also require cost delta < 1.5x per-token or throttle the canary.

Raj: +1. Obs and runbook please. Suggested telemetry set: infra_errors/5m, model_ooms, p95_latency, token_cost_ratio, hallucination_rate. Runbook short steps: 1) flip flag to 0% 2) verify model pool switch 3) notify customers and oncall. Tagging @oncall for escalation. Example queries to add to dashboards: 
```sql
-- p95 latency for v2-q4 over last 15m
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) FROM requests WHERE model='v2-q4' AND env='prod' SINCE 15m
```

Maya: Love the queries. For AB quality: we run paired prompt set with golden outputs (10k prompts). Pass if match_rate >= baseline - 1.0% and no regression on hallucination_rate measured by the eval harness. We'll also track downstream signal (conversion/engagement) where available.

Carol: Launch criteria checklist from Product POV: all three phases green, docs + support playbook published, customer comms ready, and at least two enterprise customers confirmed for opt-in dedicated testing. Also require AB quality regression < 0.5% across the golden set. If any VIP customer opts in early, coordinate a separate per-tenant rollout.

Ben: Sales note: two enterprise customers (Enterprise A, Enterprise B) asked to opt into phase2. They will accept a phased opt-in if we expose a per-tenant toggle. Please surface the toggle API and expected lead times.

Liam: Flag config suggestion and automation hooks:
```json
{
  "flag": "tenant.prio.quant.v2_q4",
  "phases": [
    {"pct":5, "duration_hours":72},
    {"pct":20, "duration_hours":24},
    {"pct":100, "duration_hours":24}
  ]
}
```
Feature hook for per-tenant override: `flag_override: {"tenant_id":12345, "pct":100}`. We should freeze other model-facing flags during the canary to limit variables.

Maya: Operational preflight checklist before Phase1:
- soak mirrored traffic in staging for 8h
- smoke eval on 10k golden prompts
- update console with per-model panels (p95, error rate, cost)
- create alert policies (pager + slack) keyed to thresholds
- publish customer comms + runbook link

Raj: Additions: set circuit-breaker to auto-fallback on model OOMs and on sustained queue growth. Quick capacity test suggestion: `ab -n 10000 -c 50` against canary pool to validate tail latencies. I'll prepare alert thresholds and oncall rotation for the 72h.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — release/v2-q4 -> canary pools (ETA 02:00 UTC) :rocket:

Maya: Final operational questions — who owns rollback for each phase? Ops oncall for Phase1 (first 72h), then eng-platform for Phase2/3. Agree to freeze other feature flags that touch the model during the canary. If no objections, schedule start tomorrow 02:00 UTC. :thumbsup:

Liam: No objections from eng-platform. I'll own the rollout automation and toggle sequence.

Raj: oncall acknowledged. I'll finish the runbook, alerts, and the dashboard panels before the start window.

Ben: Added customer comms recipients and will coordinate opt-in agreements. Thanks.

Maya: Great — booking shiproom and updating PRD now. PRD link: https://redwood/kb/prd/quant-rollout-v2. Will post final schedule when CI completes.
